accounting.attribution_disclosure: The items this lane deleted totalled 510584 KiB (499 MiB), NOT the full 1.54 GiB the volume moved. The residual ~1.07 GiB is attributable to concurrent host activity outside this lane's control — a background git auto-packing run was observed during the lane, and other lanes are active in the same repository and the same shared volume. This lane does not claim the residual as its own saving. On a shared, volatile volume the volume delta and the sum of deleted bytes are different quantities and only the latter is this lane's work.
